title_en: Abdul Wahid v. China Eastern Airlines — dispute over international air passenger transport contract
ruling_gist_en: Under the provisions of the international convention applicable to this case, in an air passenger transport where one airline issues the ticket and actually carries part of the journey, and another airline actually carries the other part, the two airlines do not constitute a successive carriage relationship under aviation law. When a passenger seeks liability for the segment actually carried by an actual carrier, the passenger may choose the defendant to sue. If the sued airline applies to join the other airline in the lawsuit, the court may decide whether to permit it based on factors such as the actual needs of the trial, litigation costs, and the convenience for the passenger to protect his/her rights.
